title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00057 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
12:45 - 14:15: Prepared for skidding. Removed hatched in moonpool. Meanwhile checked all skidding areas.
14:15 - 14:30: Performed TBT for skidding operation.
14:30 - 15:00: Skidded rig from well f-5 to f-14.
15:00 - 15:30: Installed cantilever access stairs. Performed post-skidding checks.
15:30 - 16:30: Removed hatch on f-5. Installed halfmoon hatch.
16:30 - 16:45: Pulled master bushing and outer ring.
16:45 - 17:30: Installed HP riser. M/u connector between HP riser and WH. Detached HP riser lifting equipment and pulled same to drill floor.
17:30 - 18:00: Installed master bushing and outer ring. Meanwhile performed TBT with scaffolders
18:00 - 19:00: Built scaffolding around HP riser. Meanwhile prepared diverter and slipjoint.
19:00 - 20:30: Continued building scaffolding around riser. Meanwhile cleaned cement from inside of diverter
20:30 - 21:30: Moved BOP over well center
21:30 - 22:15: Checked cantilever alignment over well center. Skidded rig 4" aft to align HP riser and BOP.
22:15 - 22:30: Landed BOP on riser.
22:30 - 23:30: M/u connector between BOP and HP riser. Meanwhile aligned tension cylinders with BOP.
23:30 - 00:00: Installed tension cylinders
